name: pencil2d-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Pencil2D traditional 2D animation creation and rendering
author: chriz-3656

tools.name: pencil2d_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a Pencil2D project (.pclx file), returning canvas resolution, FPS, keyframe counts, layers, and palette.

tools.name: pencil2d_create
tools.description: Create a new blank Pencil2D project (.pclx) with specified canvas resolution, FPS, and layers.

tools.name: pencil2d_add_frame
tools.description: Add or replace a keyframe image in a Pencil2D project bitmap layer.

tools.name: pencil2d_add_frames_batch
tools.description: Batch insert multiple animation keyframes into a project from a list or directory in a single operation.

tools.name: pencil2d_add_layer
tools.description: Add a new layer (bitmap, vector, sound, or camera) to a Pencil2D project.

tools.name: pencil2d_remove_layer
tools.description: Remove a layer from a Pencil2D project by name or ID.

tools.name: pencil2d_add_audio
tools.description: Attach a sound clip (WAV/MP3) to a sound layer at a specific keyframe in the animation.

tools.name: pencil2d_set_camera
tools.description: Configure camera keyframe positioning, panning (dx, dy), zooming (scale), and rotation angle.

tools.name: pencil2d_manage_palette
tools.description: Add or update a color swatch in the Pencil2D project palette.

tools.name: pencil2d_create_spritesheet
tools.description: Pack animation frames from a Pencil2D project into a single spritesheet image with grid metadata.

tools.name: pencil2d_validate
tools.description: Perform deep sanity and health validation on a Pencil2D project, verifying frame continuity, XML integrity, and asset health.

tools.name: pencil2d_extract_frames
tools.description: Extract all frame PNG images from a .pclx file into a target directory.

tools.name: pencil2d_export
tools.description: Render a Pencil2D animation project to video (MP4), animated GIF, or image sequence using the Pencil2D AppImage CLI.

tools.name: pencil2d_launch_gui
tools.description: Open a project (or a new workspace) inside the Pencil2D GUI for visual animation editing.

tools.name: pencil2d_look
tools.description: Visually inspect the animation by generating an animation filmstrip contact sheet (with frame numbers, timeline indicators, and onion skinning) or a single composited frame.

tools.name: pencil2d_generate_animation
tools.description: Generate a complete, high-quality stylized 2D animation project using authentic artistic styles (Stickman martial arts, Anime cel-shaded, Disney-style Pencil Sketch, Studio Ghibli landscape, Hand-drawn Doodle) with squash & stretch physics and curved lines of action.

tools.name: pencil2d_get_guide
tools.description: Retrieve craft knowledge guides on 2D animation principles, squash & stretch volume preservation, timing charts, and recipes for Stickman, Anime, Pencil Sketch, Ghibli, and Doodle styles.
